Simulation: Creating Favorites

This simulation works best on a computer.

Practice creating favorites in Oracle

In this activity, you will practice adding, removing, and reordering the favorites on your Oracle home page. Follow the instructions on the right and click on the screen just like you would at work. If you click the wrong spot, you'll get a hint.

This simulation is built for a computer. On a phone, the screens are too small to click accurately.
It starts after you've logged into Oracle.

Step

Thank you for completing this simulation!

Key points to remember:

  • Click Edit Favorites on the Oracle home page to change your list.
  • To add: pick a Responsibility, click Go, check the screens you want, then click Add.
  • To remove: check rows under Selected to Display, then click Remove.
  • Use the up and down arrows to change the order.
  • Nothing is saved until you click Apply. Cancel leaves without saving.
